# BIC Test Vectors
# Format: BIC,Valid (1/0),Country,Comment
DEUTDEFF,1,DE,Valid 8-char BIC, active
DEUTDEFF500,1,DE,Valid 11-char BIC, active
NEDSZAJJ,0,NL,Inactive BIC
DEUTDEFF5,0,DE,Invalid length
DEUTDEFFF0,0,DE,Invalid length (10)
DEUTDEFGHJK,0,DE,Not in directory, valid format
DEUTUS33,0,US,Invalid country code
DEUTDEFF@#,0,DE,Invalid chars
DEUTDE,0,DE,Too short
DEUTDEFF1234,0,DE,Too long
PBNKDEFF,1,DE,Valid BIC from map
XXXXDEFF,0,DE,Bank code not in map
PBNKDEFF1,0,DE,Invalid length (9)
PBNKDEFFXXX,1,DE,Valid 11-char BIC from map (branch)
PBNKDEFG,0,DE,Valid format, not in map or directory
